verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents an Insert Records REST API and an official MCP server that lets AI tools perform CRM operations, including bulk operations, so an agent can create the lead record. The evidence does not show company-data enrichment or owner assignment through the API or MCP; lead routing appears only as a workflow feature. Missing for 10: documented company/firmographic enrichment, explicit owner-assignment via API/MCP, end-to-end agent enrichment example, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent enrich a new lead end-to-end via the API or MCP server — creating the record, filling company data, and assigning an owner

citations.quote: To add new entities or records in a module. You can insert up to 100 records in a single API call.
This allows you to perform CRM operations directly from your AI tool using natural language, without navigating the CRM interface or working with APIs.
Zoho CRM MCP servers work with any AI tool that supports MCP, including Cursor, Claude Desktop, VS Code, and Windsurf.
Perform CRUD operations on CRM module entities and integrate with any third party application through flexible RESTful endpoints.
